s00418.summary: Luka teases stalling Teo into a game of twenty-one in the driveway.
Teo scores first; they tangle going for a rebound and argue over the foul.
Lying on the asphalt, Luka tells Teo his dad says he is staying all summer.
Teo gets up, picks up the ball, and insists they finish the game.
They collide again, the floodlight dies, and they laugh over the foul in darkness.

s00174.summary: Stranded in a fogbound gondola, Gus insists the operator will return as laughter echoes below.
The silent man in yellow demands tickets and unmasks a painted grin; Gus recognizes Pike.
The gondola drops and stops while Pike's grin widens.

s00892.summary: Guests gather in the motel ice alcove, uneasy about the shuddering machine.
Hiram arrives and the clerk dismisses the knocking as pipes.
Dot and Lorraine reveal guests heard their names; Lorraine heard her dead mother's voice.
Over Dot's objections, Gideon unlocks the machine and finds a woman's eyes in the ice.

s00231.summary: Inspector Lindqvist questions Constance about her dead partner and a quarrel over a heron.
He presses her about a safe-shaped hole behind the heron.
A soaked delivery boy brings a ticking parcel for the dead Mr. Pennington.
Inside the parcel, a watch and a note tell them to look behind the heron.

s01552.summary: Opposing counsel share an anteroom, awkwardly bumping hands on a stapler and trading quips before court.

s01252.summary: Detective Seraphina records an apology in her parked car in the rain.
She replays her notes and deduces the dead man was swapped and Corwin Hale is alive.
Headlights turn into the quarry; she records her last words and the light floods the car.

s01743.summary: Osvaldo pushes Kiki to admit she likes new girl Prisha; they trade denials.
Kiki and Osvaldo both blurt that they like Prisha, and Kiki kills the music.

s01872.summary: An alarm sounds and the crew scrambles to seal a hull breach in the greenhouse.
The breach is contained and Vance steadies shaken Cadet Delacroix to close the airlock.

s01686.summary: Rival bowlers Arnold and Minnie trade strikes, gutters and smug looks.
They reach for the same ball; Deacon points out the rack.
Minnie bowls a strike and bows; the score is a razor-thin lead and they shove to the board.

s00103.summary: Soldiers keep watch in the bell tower; the captain reports quiet by field phone.
Elijah asks about the bells ringing before attacks and why the captain keeps checking.
A bell hums in the belfry, the light turns pale gold, and it rings.

s01239.summary: Girl Nina builds a sugar tower while a silent stranger enters; she guesses him a plumber.
The man asks about a fridge photo and Nina names her father Tomas.
Tomas sits, Nina notes his nose, and lets him add a cube to the tower.
She calls him Daddy, acknowledges his stay may be brief, and chooses to build taller.

s00434.summary: Inspector Clementine pours tea for Sir Aldous in the dead conservatory.
She spots a conservatory leaf on his cuff, disproving his London alibi.
She signals; constables emerge from the hedges and he sets down his cup.

s02348.summary: Teens argue over a dead bus on the tracks while Devi hunts for a phone signal.
Devi reaches 911 as a train approaches; they argue where they are.
The horn nears and the three run hand in hand into the weeds.

s00571.summary: Defense counsel Voss cross-examines dock clerk Brandvold about a whistle she heard.
Voss shows the lower-landing whistle was out of service, and Brandvold admits she may be wrong.
Thornquist withdraws the second count rather than rest a case on a broken whistle.
At the bench, Judge Pruitt dismisses count two and teases Elias for letting Voss win.
Voss and Thornquist banter about dinner and leave together.

s01495.summary: Detectives question those who found a body at the fish market.
Yasmine has Diego identify the dead man by lifting the tarp.
Diego and Perpetua reveal Koval visited weekly for private money talks with the owner.
Bartholomew demands a lawyer and is escorted out as dawn arrives.

s00267.summary: Courier Sabrina gives a nonsense story about a delayed bag to a deadpan security guard.
Inspector Mira reveals she knows about the handcuffed case.
Sabrina swings the case at Vic, clips Mira, and runs; Mira calls her back.
The case springs open empty and Sabrina learns it was always empty.
Sabrina sinks to the floor laughing and Vic offers her tea.

s01801.summary: William races to the seawall to find Cecilia, who missed her train.
She admits she lingered hoping he would come; the porter discreetly looks away.
Their hands collide over the windblown ticket; she says anywhere he is, and he takes her hand.

s02396.summary: Sheriff Tull and Cordelia face off with guns across a bridge while a coach wheel is stuck.
Wendell shoves at the jammed wheel as the preacher prays and Cordelia needles him.
The wheel frees; Tull and Cordelia aim, then she lowers her rifle before the preacher.

s01319.summary: Archive staff bicker about temperature while an unnoticed stranger stands near the doors.
Asha notices the stacks blinking in counts as the stranger opens an empty toolbox.
Marcel asks who let him in; lights blink in unison and the stranger says they have waited ten years.
The humming rises, the stranger flickers as a projection, and the vault seals.
With blue eyes he speaks as the archive, saying they kept secrets and must keep theirs.
Marcel lowers the extinguisher and Wren asks where they begin.

s01532.summary: Penny guards her peach pie while Grandma Maude watches and the judge circulates.
Willie bursts in four minutes late with a burnt-looking pie.
Judge Cromwell questions Willie and samples the lopsided blackberry pie.
He disqualifies Willie but pins the rare Judge's Indulgence rosette on him.
Penny wins first place, Maude smiles, and the stunned teens follow her out grinning.

s00740.summary: Mortimer answers every question with buzzwords while Lakshmi and Duncan press for substance.

s00702.summary: The fool echoes Lady Vaneth's report to King Osric, who asks him for a song.

s01504.summary: Four people bury a small grave; the boy takes the spade and finishes it himself.
The woman lifts her veil and asks who is going to tell the boy.

s01494.summary: Three soldiers hiding in a silo search the radio and argue over Berlin or Brussels.
Jonah asks if they will be all right; Casimir answers with dark humor and they grin.
A droning begins overhead and they identify the engines as friendly.
They sit back down and resume cleaning and music.

s00440.summary: Ben burns the balloon's flame as it sinks, holding an unopened ring box.
Ben tries to propose but fumbles the box; their hands meet on the lid.
A farmer offers a ride; they laugh and Celeste opens the box.
Celeste tells him to ask on the ground; Ben lets the flame sigh.

s01120.summary: Bram demands his mother account for missing deposit money in front of customers.
He slams the keys down, scattering glass eyes as they both grab a tray.
Bram admits he gambled away the Hendry money at the track.
Odalys exhales and tells Bram to pick up every eye; Hosea shows his dead canary.

s02289.summary: Sleepless dying Solomon trades quiet remarks with the new night nurse.
Solomon recalls his wife humming like a kettle and learns the nurse's name.
Solomon asks if his son is coming; Danielle's kind lie stays unchallenged as she sits.
Danielle hums like a kettle as his hand slackens on hers.
